Estimate Website Traffic From Your Own Data

This free website traffic estimator is designed for planning, not for guessing private competitor analytics. Add your current monthly visits, expected growth rate, average pages per visit and ad RPM to build a transparent traffic forecast. You can also paste keyword data with monthly search volume or impressions and a Google position to estimate potential organic visits from those rankings.

Traffic forecastProject monthly visits over 1–36 months using the growth rate you choose.
SEO estimateTurn keyword volume and ranking positions into a modelled organic-visit estimate.
Revenue scenarioEstimate pageviews and ad revenue from your own pages-per-visit and RPM assumptions.

How the website traffic estimate is calculated

If you enter current monthly visits, that value becomes the baseline for the forecast. The calculator compounds the monthly growth percentage across the selected projection period. Projected pageviews are then calculated from projected visits multiplied by your average pages per visit, while the ad-revenue scenario uses pageviews and the RPM value you provide.

The optional keyword section uses a position-based click-through-rate model. Higher Google positions receive a larger estimated share of the search volume or impressions you enter. The tool also shows a range around the keyword estimate because real CTR varies by query intent, SERP features, device, brand familiarity and the quality of the search snippet. This makes the result useful for scenario planning, but it should not be treated as an exact traffic measurement.

When a traffic estimator is useful

  • Forecasting how monthly website traffic could change if a realistic growth rate continues.
  • Estimating the traffic opportunity behind keywords that already have known search volume and ranking positions.
  • Comparing two SEO scenarios, such as moving an important keyword from page two into the top ten.
  • Estimating pageviews and advertising revenue before setting a content or traffic target.
  • Creating a simple planning report without connecting Google Analytics, Search Console or a paid SEO API.

Use first-party numbers whenever possible

For your own site, use recent monthly visits from your analytics platform and real search impressions or keyword positions from Google Search Console where available. If you are testing a future scenario, change one assumption at a time so you can see which factor is driving the result. For example, keep the traffic baseline fixed and compare different ranking positions, or keep rankings fixed and compare several monthly growth rates.

What this calculator does not claim

Entering a domain name does not make the tool read that website’s private analytics. The domain field is only a report label. UptimeFixer does not present the calculated number as exact live competitor traffic. Third-party traffic estimators can also differ substantially because they use their own datasets and models, so important business decisions should be checked against first-party analytics whenever you control the website.
